scientific_boundary: writer+binder+shadow realized; final four-arm effect measurement not authorized
lessons: A same-trajectory success/failure writer intervention can produce distinct valid ReasoningBank memories without implying that those differences reliably move the downstream first-decision distribution.
Noise calibration matters: cross-branch TV that equals or only intermittently exceeds within-branch TV does not earn transport authority under the frozen PACTA gate.

On this step-0 MiniSWEAgent surface, five of six pilot units fail the strict two-block noise-calibrated gate; only the pylint unit shows stable branch separation substantially above within-branch variation.
A gate-geometry failure before A0/A1/A2/A3 measurement is not a method-effect estimate. It qualifies a selection criterion, not the final intervention effect.

Initial-decision state conditioning should be described narrowly: before the first shell action, no repository observation has been returned, so the SCB adapter conditions on the coding task plus the initial agent state, not on a post-action repository observation.

Do not rescue a sparse gate by tuning the threshold, adding samples, consuming sealed reserve, or switching to a smaller Qwen model after observing this outcome. A revised selection rule would require a new method object and new prospective substrate.

belief_update.increase: Confidence that the W->first-decision transport bottleneck is real even under a stronger ReasoningBank carrier and a very strong Qwen policy: writer differences are easy to realize, but stable action-distribution separation remains sparse.
belief_update.decrease: Confidence that the current strict PACTA noise-calibrated gate is broadly usable as a six-unit selection mechanism at MiniSWEAgent step 0.
belief_update.unchanged: No direct belief update about A3-vs-rate-matched-random effectiveness because the final method-effect stage was never opened.

reopen_condition: Any new PACTA-style selector must be preregistered as a new scientific object on fresh source/future pairs before its selection outcomes are observed. The three sealed units from this epoch remain sealed and are not a rescue set.
